Python Integer square root precision bug
buggyCode:
def is_perfect_square(n):
    if n < 0:
        return False
    root = int(n ** 0.5)
    return root * root == n

print(is_perfect_square(26))
print(is_perfect_square(25))
testCode:
assert is_perfect_square(25) == True
assert is_perfect_square(26) == False
assert is_perfect_square(0) == True
assert is_perfect_square(-4) == False
print('ALL_PASSED')
